name: V361P1_V341FixedControls_DevA2_LongDev_2GPU_a1
display_name: V361-P1 V341 frozen baseline and fixed long-document controls (two GPUs)
summary: Run the exact V341-D1 256-token baseline and the chunk320 overlap64 Max, Top-2 Mean, and LogSumExp controls on frozen Dev-A2 and Long-Dev with two GPUs. Test-B and Long-Stress remain unread.
notes: The baseline uses the original V341 tokenizer truncation at 256 tokens.
The fixed controls encode every chunk once and reuse the logits for all three pooling rules.
Two GPUs run one baseline and one fixed control each, with subruns on a single GPU always serial.
No training, OOF, Test-B, or Long-Stress access is permitted in this run.
